reviews.title: Pass, unless I am missing something
reviews.text: The game is just boring. Your “choices” devolve to just preference of order. The choices for characters is your choice between an AD or no ad. All choices at a neighborhood level feel, even when choosing “to ignore” being pickpocketed, still results in police heat. Spend $30 USD and you get to skip basically 10 ads a day, not really worth it. Your only real customization is your choice between man/woman at the beginning, who leads the family when the don dies, and then the family name. Learn from me and pass unless they make serious reform or you need a “story” to click through.

reviews.title: Fixt this please
reviews.text: The game really needs an organized hierarchy for recruited characters. Right now, everyone keeps hiring endlessly, creating a messy chain where you can’t even read the mafia tree. It would be much better to structure them as boss, underboss, capo, soldier for clearer control. Business assignments also feel random, since anyone can be placed anywhere. On top of that, character deaths happen too randomly; instead, each character should have a system of mistakes that eventually leads to death, not just an instant and unexplained loss. Overall, the game feels very disorganized.
